Milo’s Fund is the project’s humorous name for the founder’s 20% allocation of creator fees, intended to support Load’s ongoing living and operational needs. It is not 20% of token supply.

CHAPTER I — THE GOLDEN AGE

A CITY BUILT FOR KINGS

Once upon a time, Mane City was a paradise of endless wealth, dazzling lights, and limitless ambition. Its citizens lived like kings. Empires rose beneath golden skies, fortunes were built overnight, and every Lion believed the future belonged to them.

As the years passed, new lands emerged beyond the city's borders. Unknown territories were discovered, civilizations expanded, and Mane City's influence spread further than ever before.

But something else was coming. Something that did not belong to their time.

CHAPTER II — THE GREAT FALL

WHEN DARKNESS WON

From a distant future, the Dark Lions arrived. They brought a vision of absolute control, a future where freedom was nothing more than a forgotten memory.

Standing against them was LEGION, an army of 10,000 legendary Loaded Lions, warriors who swore to protect Mane City at any cost. To destroy LEGION, the Dark Lions formed their own faction: THE VOID.

A war unlike anything Mane City had ever witnessed consumed the land. The Lions fought with everything they had. But courage was not enough.

One by one, all 10,000 warriors of LEGION were captured and imprisoned inside digital cells, condemned to an eternity of silence. The city fell. The light disappeared. The Void had won.

◉ ENCRYPTED TRANSMISSION // UNKNOWN SOURCE

CHAPTER III — THE LAST BLOODLINE

THE LION THEY FORGOT

Centuries passed. Mane City became a corrupted empire, ruled and manipulated by The Void. Its citizens could do nothing but survive, watching their oppressors prosper.

The legendary Loaded Lions became nothing more than forgotten ghosts. The Void believed it had erased every trace of LEGION. It was wrong.

Somewhere in the shadows, a young Lion carried a secret that could change everything. His name was LOAD. Son of a legendary Loaded Lion. The last surviving descendant of LEGION. The only one who still carried the blood of the fallen warriors. And perhaps the last hope Mane City would ever have.

CHAPTER IV — THE AWAKENING

ONE LION AT A TIME

LOAD knew he could never defeat The Void alone. He needed an army. But his army was still alive, trapped inside the digital prisons of a forgotten war.

So he created something The Void could never fully control: $LOAD. A token born to spread across the people of Mane City, carrying the energy needed to awaken the imprisoned LEGION.

Every trade fuels the mission. Every Loaded Lion recovered represents another warrior freed from the darkness. But there is a cruel twist of fate: LOAD cannot choose who awakens. The liberation process is unpredictable. One Lion at a time. One chance at a time.

Somewhere among those 10,000 prisoners is his father. He doesn't know when — or if — he will ever find him. Yet he keeps going. Because somewhere beyond the digital walls, The Void still believes the LEGION bloodline is extinct. It has no idea that the awakening has already begun.

THE ROAR IS JUST BEGINNING.ONE LION AT A TIME. UNTIL THE LEGION RISES AGAIN.
